shots.visual: A stern leader smiling subtly while pouring tea inside a warm dimly lit army tent.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 將軍，帶五千騎兵去潼關喝茶。

shots.visual: A strategist in robes holding a feather fan looks surprised at the calm ruler sitting opposite.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公早料到司馬懿會反？

shots.visual: The sharp-eyed leader swirling his tea cup with cold determination.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 狼終究是狼，順便給他設個局。

shots.visual: A grand empty palace hall shadowed in dark red torchlight, eerie atmosphere.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 洛陽城內，暗潮洶湧。

shots.visual: A brave female warrior steps into the tent and swiftly unrolls a secret map scroll on the table.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 這是我從東吳帶出的密道圖！

shots.visual: The leader looks up from the tactical blueprint toward the brave heroine.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 香兒，這次辛苦你了。

shots.visual: The female warrior clenches her fist tightly, showing mixed feelings of grief and resolve.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 只要能結束戰亂，臣妾無悔！

shots.visual: The strategist points his feather fan directly onto the capital city located on the map.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 直取建業，東吳可一舉而定！

shots.visual: A vast fleet of giant wooden warships sailing through thick river fog at dusk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 大軍連夜拔寨，直逼東吳腹地。

shots.visual: The leader in golden armor stands firmly at the bow of the warship, red cape fluttering violently in the wind.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權，這一天我等太久了！

shots.visual: A suspicious ruler in purple robes sweating profusely, eyes wide with horror.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備居然繞過了江防？！

shots.visual: Massive dust clouds rising from the horizon as cavalry charges across the muddy battlefield.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 蜀軍神兵天降，江東防線潰敗！

shots.visual: The enemy ruler violently unsheathes his bronze sword, shouting wildly.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 全軍集結！隨我死守城門！

shots.visual: The female warrior gazes at the distant burning city, a tear trickling down her cheek.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 兄長，你為何執迷不悟…

shots.visual: The protagonist unsheathes a glowing silver blade, eyes burning with fierce ambition.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 全軍聽令，攻破建業城門！

shots.visual: The calm advisor watching the assault from atop a command hill, holding his fan still.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 大局已定，就看洛陽那邊了。

shots.visual: A lonely mountain pass fortress surrounded by swirling snowstorms.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 此時潼關關口，殺機暗藏。

shots.visual: The towering iron gates of the massive capital fortress slowly creak open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 轟隆一聲，建業城門大開！

shots.visual: The enemy commander stands in front of elite guards, glaring venomously at the advancing army.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備！你以為你贏了嗎？

shots.visual: The main protagonist raises his sword chin-high with cold contempt.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 成王敗寇，洗乾淨脖子吧。

shots.visual: Extreme low-angle close up of the enraged enemy lord swinging his sword straight down at the camera, freeze frame.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 想要建業，先問問我的劍！
